s: Seder tepillat mincha ubo v' seipim: en omerim "en kelohenu" achar tepillat musap, kemo sheomerim bishar shabbat veyom tob, lepi sheiqqaro lo nitqan ella keneged berakot emtzaiyyot shel tepillat shemoneh esreh sheen omerim otan beshabbat veyom tob, abal beyom hakkippurim kebar ameru piyyutim sheyyesh bahem hazkarot berakot ellu kegon "ahallelka ku'". Abal "pittum haqqetoret", ap al pi sheggam hi nizkera baaboda, mikkol maqom perate samemane haqqetoret lo huzkeru sham, velaken yesh leomram achar tepillat musap:

Yesh meqomot nohagim lomar "ashre uba letziyyon" qodem tepillat hammincha kemo bekol shabbat veyom tob, abal bimdinot ellu en omerim "ashre uba letziyyon" ad qodem neila, kede lehapsiq ben tepillat mincha linila baamirat "ashre uba letziyyon", abal ben musap lemincha mapsiqin biqriat hattora, lepikak en tzarik lehapsiq od be"ashre uba letziyyon", veyesh lanu lemaher tepillat hammincha bekol mah deepshar:

En omerim "vaani tepillati" apillu im chal lihyot beshabbat, lepi shebbekol hashshabbatot omerim oto lishbach yisrael, sheap al pi sheakelu veshatu ap al pi ken hem qorin battora umitpalelin achar kak, mah sheen ken ummot haolam sheokelin veshotin upochazin, abal beyom hakkippurim en shayyak zeh:

Umotziin seper tora veqorin shelosha anashim beparashat arayot ad sop happarasha, shemmi sheyyesh abera beyado yiprosh mehen, lepi shehaarayot abera metzuya shennapsho shel adam mechammadtan veyitzro toqepo, vehashshelishi maptir beyona, lepi sheyyesh bo koach hatteshuba vesheen yekolin libroach meet pene haqqadosh baruk hu, venohagim lesayyem hahaptara bemika "mi el kamoka ku'". Veachar hahaptara nohagin bimdinot ellu shello lebarek raq shalosh berakot, abal en omerim "al hattora veal haaboda", lepi shekkebar nigmera abodat hayyom qodem hammincha. Venohagim bimdinot ellu sheen omerim "tzidqateka" keshechal beshabbat, lepi shekkatub bo "mishpateka tehom rabba", veen anu mebaqqeshin mishpat beyom hakkippurim ella rachamim velipnim mishshurat haddin, keen shenneemar "veal tabo bemishpat ku'":
Im hashshaa dechuqa — yedallegu "abinu malkenu", kede lehatchil neila bizmannah sheyyitbaer besiman trk"g:

Ap al pi sheen nesiat kappayim bemincha beyom hakkippurim kemo shennitbaer besiman qk"t ayyen sham, ap al pi ken yomar hashsheliach tzibbur birkat kohanim ve"sim shalom" mittaam shennitbaer sham, ayyen sham:
